python-retry-backoff.title: First retry waits twice the configured base
python-retry-backoff.body: The retry helper uses one-based attempt numbers. Preserve validation and the existing cap.

java-batch-window.title: Expose remaining batch capacity
java-batch-window.body: Consumers need an immutable capacity query and exact-fill acceptance.

rust-structured-limit-error.title: Replace free-form parser errors
rust-structured-limit-error.body: Downstream code needs exhaustive error categories while CLI wording remains stable.

go-dedupe-index.title: Remove quadratic duplicate checks
go-dedupe-index.body: Preserve first-occurrence order and expose a deterministic membership-check count.
acceptance_criteria: checks no greater than input length

typescript-idempotency.title: Duplicate side effects under concurrent idempotency keys
typescript-idempotency.body: Coalesce equivalent in-flight work without globally serializing unrelated keys.

cpp-binary-search.title: Sorted lookup misses boundary values
cpp-binary-search.body: Use a consistent interval and distinguish insertion position from an actual match.
